description.en: Understand where your brand appears in AI answers.
description.zh: 了解品牌在 AI 回答中的曝光表现。

guide.en: Start with the engines your audience uses, then compare monitoring frequency, prompt coverage and reporting. A mention is different from a cited link: check which metric each product measures.
guide.zh: 先确定受众常用的 AI 平台，再比较监测频率、提示词覆盖和报表能力。品牌提及与链接引用不同，选型时需明确各产品测量的指标。

description.en: Find the sources behind AI-generated answers.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 回答引用的内容与来源。

guide.en: Citation tracking identifies the pages and domains used in an answer. Compare source-level detail and the ability to investigate individual prompts; a tracked citation does not guarantee referral traffic.
guide.zh: 引用追踪关注回答使用了哪些页面和域名。优先比较来源明细和单个提示词的分析能力；被引用并不保证带来网站访问。

description.en: Follow the questions that matter to your business.
description.zh: 持续观察与业务相关的问题。

guide.en: A useful prompt set reflects real buying questions, languages and markets. Keep prompts consistent over time and check whether a tool measures repeated responses rather than a single answer.
guide.zh: 有效的提示词集合应覆盖真实购买问题、语言和市场。持续使用一致的问题，留意工具是反复采样还是仅分析单次回答。

description.en: See how your brand compares in AI search.
description.zh: 比较品牌与竞品的 AI 搜索表现。

guide.en: Compare brands on the same prompts, engines and regions. Share of voice only has meaning within a defined sample; examine cited sources and underlying answers before making decisions.
guide.zh: 在相同提示词、平台和地区下比较品牌。声量份额取决于样本范围，判断前应查看引用来源和原始回答。

description.en: Check whether your website is ready for AI discovery.
description.zh: 检查网站是否便于 AI 发现与理解。

guide.en: Audits help uncover content and technical barriers. Prefer findings that link to an affected page and an actionable fix. A proprietary readiness score is a diagnostic aid, not a promise of AI visibility.
guide.zh: 诊断用于发现内容和技术障碍。优先选择能定位具体页面并提供可执行修复建议的工具。就绪评分是辅助指标，不是曝光保证。

description.en: Make your content clearer, more useful and easier to cite.
description.zh: 让内容更清楚、更有用，也更便于引用。

guide.en: Look for workflows that improve factual coverage, structure and editorial quality. Use AI suggestions as a starting point, verify claims and keep human review before publication.
guide.zh: 关注能改善事实覆盖、内容结构和编辑质量的流程。AI 建议仅作为起点，发布前仍需核验信息并人工审核。

description.en: Understand the visits arriving from AI platforms.
description.zh: 了解来自 AI 平台的实际访问。

guide.en: Referral analytics measures visits, not every brand mention. Referrer information can be missing, and AI crawler requests differ from human visits. Compare attribution limits before interpreting results.
guide.zh: 来源分析统计访问，而非所有品牌提及。部分访问可能缺少来源信息，AI 爬虫请求也不同于真人访问；解读数据前需了解归因局限。

description.en: Explore AI search visibility for local businesses.
description.zh: 发现面向本地企业的 AI 搜索工具。

guide.en: Local visibility depends on the location, language and intent of a question. Compare support for individual locations and local competitors; traditional map rankings and AI recommendations measure different things.
guide.zh: 本地曝光受提问地点、语言和意图影响。比较工具对门店和本地竞品的支持；传统地图排名与 AI 推荐衡量的是不同结果。
